description: Source code implementing a 14-bit algebraic codebook search for AMR speech codec, including functions for codebook search, building code vectors, and related algorithms.

methods.name: code_3i40_14bits
methods.description: Searches a 14-bit algebraic codebook with 3 pulses in a 40-sample frame, returning the index and generating the codevector, filtered code, and pulse signs.

methods.name: search_3i40
methods.description: Internal static function that searches for the best codevector by evaluating pulse positions and signs.

methods.name: build_code
methods.description: Builds the algebraic codebook vector, filtered code, and pulse signs based on pulse positions and signs.
